description: Draws 1 to 10 distinct cards at random from the 78-card tarot deck and returns the reading of each, in the order drawn: a card of the day, or a free spread whose positions you assign in that order. It returns the app's text for each card, not a synthesis: reading the draw as a whole for the person's question (each card in its position, the cards together) is left to the assistant, from these texts only.

deck.description: full: all 78 cards (default); majors: the 22 major arcana.

detail.description: full: each card's whole reading; short: its opening meaning, as in a spread (default: full up to 3 cards, short beyond).

language.description: Language of the readings: en, fr, es, pt-BR, ja or de (default en). Use the language of the conversation.

question.description: The person's question, in her words, if she asked one (never stored).

name: tarot_draw
title: Tarot reading (draw cards)
